plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while introducing a hedge. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, balancing growth with risk management.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETFs.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to prioritize income and steady distributions.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
